public.hero.fitBody: After the Interview, the app adjusts spacing and text size and, where needed, attempts to shorten descriptions with factual checks. If the CV still spans several pages, it checks other available templates and shows those that fit the same content on one page.
public.hero.fitQuestion: Will every CV fit on one page?
public.hero.fitAnswer: Not always. The result depends on the amount of content and the template. After the Interview, we check the layout and offer measured alternatives. Changing the template preserves the content and uses no AI credits; shortening and checking text use credits. You can keep a longer CV.
public.publicPages.fitIntro: After drafting your content, the Interview checks the page count automatically. It first adjusts the layout, then attempts fact-checked shortening where needed. You can restore the version from before fitting.
public.publicPages.fitTemplates: If the result still has several pages, you will see a comparison of available templates. Choose a template where the app has measured a single-page result using the same content. Comparison and template changes use no AI credits. If none fits, keep the longer document or edit it in Studio.
